Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building ages, sizes, portables, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessments by Bureau Veritas covering all major systems; connection of condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Chapters 2, 5; Facility Condition Assessments; Executive Summary).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with methodology based on demographic and county data; capacity utilization data by site and grade with square footage and student counts; explicit connection of enrollment trends to facility actions including consolidation and new construction (Introduction and Process, pp. 26-28; Demographic and Capacity Assessment).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; comprehensive analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, collaborative learning, and technology (Introduction and Process, pp. 21-25; Facilities Assessments, Educational Suitability).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including play yards, gardens, and athletic fields; identifies strategies for improvement such as shade structures, outdoor classrooms, and play structures; references outdoor learning and wellness but not fully districtwide or detailed (Staff and Community Input; Site Analysis and Master Plans).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related issues such as stormwater drainage problems and corrosive marine environment impacts; however, lacks comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies across multiple climate impacts (Facility Condition Assessments; Site Analysis).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions some energy efficiency projects such as LED lighting upgrades and HVAC improvements; lacks comprehensive energy data, resilience strategies, or references to state mandates like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Facility Condition Assessments; Bond Implementation Priorities).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed capital strategy with itemized cost estimates, phased project prioritization, and multiple funding sources including bonds and state grants; includes escalation assumptions and contingencies; aligns financial capacity with district priorities and long-term sustainability (Program Costs, Bond Implementation Priorities, Cost Models).
